description.text: The third expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 28 July 2023. Charizard ex leads it as a Tera Pokémon of the Darkness type: the set brought the first Tera Pokémon whose Tera Type differs from their own type, among them Tyranitar ex of the Lightning type and Eiscue ex of the Fire type. Pidgeot ex, Glimmora ex and Revavroom ex join them, with Pokémon League chair Geeta and Team Star's Ortega as Supporters for the first time, and Poppy. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 108, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Ultra Rare Charizard ex, Artazon and basic Fire Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Obsidian Flames in August 2023.
